rules.content:
SELECT
    d.domain_name,
    d.domain_age_days,
    d.registrar,
    COUNT(DISTINCT q.source_ip) AS unique_endpoints,
    COUNT(*) AS total_queries,
    COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(q.query_timestamp)) AS active_days,
    AVG(q.ttl_seconds) AS avg_ttl,
    COUNT(DISTINCT q.cname_target) AS cname_chain_depth,
    CASE
        WHEN d.domain_age_days < 30 AND COUNT(DISTINCT q.source_ip) > 50 THEN 'HIGH'
        WHEN d.domain_age_days < 90 AND COUNT(DISTINCT q.source_ip) > 20 THEN 'MEDIUM'
        ELSE 'LOW'
    END AS risk_level
FROM dns_query_logs q
JOIN domain_intelligence d ON q.queried_domain = d.domain_name
WHERE q.query_timestamp >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'
  AND d.category IN ('uncategorized', 'newly_registered', 'suspicious')
  AND d.domain_age_days < 90
GROUP BY d.domain_name, d.domain_age_days, d.registrar
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT q.source_ip) >= 10
   AND AVG(q.ttl_seconds) < 300
ORDER BY unique_endpoints DESC, total_queries DESC;
rules.title: SQL -- TDS Domain Contact Rate Analysis (Phase 4)

rules.content:
index=proxy sourcetype=web_proxy
| transaction session_id maxspan=30s
| eval redirect_count = mvcount(dest_domain) - 1
| where redirect_count >= 3
| eval unique_domains = mvdedup(dest_domain)
| eval unique_domain_count = mvcount(unique_domains)
| where unique_domain_count >= 3
| lookup domain_age_lookup domain AS dest_domain OUTPUT domain_age_days
| eval young_domains = mvfilter(domain_age_days < 30 OR isnull(domain_age_days))
| eval young_domain_count = mvcount(young_domains)
| where young_domain_count >= 2
| eval chain_domains = mvjoin(unique_domains, " -> ")
| stats count AS occurrences,
        dc(src_ip) AS affected_endpoints,
        values(chain_domains) AS redirect_chains,
        values(http_status) AS status_codes
    BY session_id
| where occurrences > 0
| sort - affected_endpoints
| table session_id, affected_endpoints, redirect_chains, status_codes, occurrences
rules.title: Splunk -- Multi-Hop Redirect Chain Detection (Phase 3)

rules.content:
title: DNS CNAME Resolution to Newly Provisioned Cloud Resource
status: experimental
description: >
  Detects DNS CNAME records belonging to high-reputation organizational domains
  that resolve to cloud service endpoints (Azure, AWS, GitHub Pages, Cloudflare)
  where the underlying resource was recently provisioned. This pattern is
  consistent with Hazy Hawk-style DNS hijacking of abandoned cloud resources,
  where attackers register new cloud resources matching orphaned CNAME targets
  to inherit trusted domain reputation for TDS entry point deployment.
logsource:
    product: dns
    service: passive_dns
detection:
    selection_cname:
        record_type: 'CNAME'
        cname_target|contains:
            - '.azurewebsites.net'
            - '.cloudfront.net'
            - '.s3.amazonaws.com'
            - '.github.io'
            - '.pages.dev'
            - '.herokuapp.com'
    filter_known_resources:
        cloud_resource_age_days|gte: 90
    selection_reputation:
        parent_domain_reputation: 'trusted'
    condition: selection_cname and selection_reputation and not filter_known_resources
level: high
tags:
    - cfpf.phase2.initial_access
    - attack.t1583.001
    - attack.t1036
    - flame.tds
    - flame.dns_hijack
    - flame.hazy_hawk
rules.title: Sigma -- CNAME Hijacking Detection (Hazy Hawk Pattern) (Phase 2)

rules.content:
title: DNS Queries to Suspected RDGA-Generated Domains
status: experimental
description: >
  Detects DNS queries from enterprise endpoints to domains exhibiting
  characteristics of Registered Domain Generation Algorithm (RDGA) output,
  including high-entropy names, algorithmic structure, recent registration,
  and low TTL values. RDGA domains are used by TDS operators (notably VexTrio)
  to maintain large pools of disposable redirect relay domains.
logsource:
    product: dns
    service: dns_query
detection:
    selection:
        query_name|re: '^[a-z0-9]{8,15}\.(top|xyz|click|link|online|site|info|buzz)$'
    filter_legitimate:
        query_name|contains:
            - 'google'
            - 'microsoft'
            - 'amazon'
            - 'cloudflare'
    condition: selection and not filter_legitimate
    aggregation:
        count|gte: 5
        groupby: src_ip
        timeframe: 10m
level: medium
tags:
    - cfpf.phase3.positioning
    - attack.t1583.001
    - attack.t1090.002
    - flame.tds
    - flame.rdga
    - flame.vextrio
rules.title: Sigma -- RDGA Domain Pattern Detection (Phase 3)
